data.explanation: Your US student health plan received your claim for the emergency room visit on 21 August 2026. To process it, they need an itemized bill and proof of payment. These must be received by 30 September 2026, otherwise the claim will be closed. Send both documents to the insurer (for example by email to the claims address in the letter) and keep a copy. If you can't get the itemized bill from the hospital in time, contact the insurer and ask about an extension.
